---
name: Bug report
about: Describe a problem with evidence and a clear expected result.
type: Bug
---

<!-- Make this understandable without the original conversation. Include what is
known; missing reproduction or diagnosis should be stated, not guessed.
Remove these guidance comments from the final issue. -->

## Current behavior and impact
<!-- What happens now, and who or what does it affect? Describe the observed
behavior and practical impact. Include when it started or last worked if known. -->

## Reproduction and evidence
<!-- Give the smallest useful reproduction: starting conditions, steps or input,
and the actual result. Prefer a form that can be run, such as a command, script or
failing test. Identify the relevant environment, version or revision when known,
and whether the problem is consistent or intermittent. Paste exact error text and
the relevant log lines; link screenshots or failing runs as supporting evidence.
Redact secrets and sensitive data. If it cannot be reproduced reliably, describe
the observations available. -->

## Expected behavior
<!-- What should happen instead? Use a checklist for multiple outcomes. Include
relevant behavior that must continue working; these are the criteria for the fix. -->

## Investigation so far
<!-- Separate confirmed findings from hypotheses. Record attempted fixes, their
results and explanations already ruled out, with evidence where available.
Label any proposed fix as a suggestion. Omit this section if not investigated. -->

## Verification
<!-- How will the fix be demonstrated? Reuse the reproduction where possible and
identify relevant regression cases. Note any environment or access needed to check
the behavior. Do not repeat checks already clear from the expected behavior. -->

## Dependencies and open questions
<!-- Set a parent epic or blocking issues with GitHub's sub-issue and blocked-by
links when relevant, and link other related issues here. State gaps that affect
the fix or its verification, distinguishing blockers from questions that can be
answered during investigation. -->
